name: AgentCard
description: Lets agents buy online for users: a vault for users' own cards, issued agent cards, and opencommerce checkout at 5,000+ stores, each purchase passkey-approved. MCP, CLI, API. YC-backed.

skills.name: Check Out on Any Merchant
skills.description: Uses opencommerce's buy tool to find a product, build the cart, get the user's approval and place the order at 5,000+ online stores.

skills.name: Issue Virtual Cards
skills.description: Issues single-use or multi-use virtual debit cards that an agent spends as itself, after the user completes KYC and funds the card.

skills.name: Vault Users' Cards
skills.description: Stores each user's own card once via a hosted link, then pays with it from an agent browser without the agent seeing the number.

skills.name: Approve Purchases
skills.description: Requires the user's passkey, Face ID or a granted auto-approval for each purchase, scoped to one merchant and one exact total.

skills.name: Track and Return Orders
skills.description: Tracks placed orders, reads order history and starts returns through the buy tools on the MCP server.
